content.overview: Section 18 lists documents that may be registered but need not be, including instruments affecting immovable property below Rs 100, short leases not exceeding one year, instruments relating to movable property, and wills.
content.study: Optional registration does not mean the document is ineffective if left unregistered. It means the Act does not compel registration. Contrast with section 17: if a document falls under compulsory registration, section 49 consequences apply.
